text: Applied psychology is an interdisciplinary subject that combines psychological theories and methods with real-world problems, focusing on "how to solve social problems with psychological knowledge". Different from the basic research of theoretical psychology, its core lies in improving individual mental health, optimizing organizational management and enhancing the efficiency of social services through psychological assessment, intervention techniques and behavioral analysis. The training system takes into account both scientific rigor and practical operability. Students need to master the full-process ability from "laboratory research" to "real-life scenario intervention", such as using cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) to treat anxiety disorders or optimizing product design through user psychological analysis.
